summary: Iteration 48 — USER VERIFICATION run (frontend-only, mobile 390x844, alex+test1@jaleter.app). All 5 targeted checks (a, b, c + 2 regressions) PASS. Runtime evidence captured for (a) NO-FLASH, (c) MONTHLY SURPLUS DRILL sheet, and Activity filter regression. (b) BUILD math + (regression) Home==Legacy BUILD verified via deterministic code review of /app/frontend/app/index.tsx L4060-4065 (LegacyScreen.buildProjectionAt) and L1257-1262 (HomeScreen.buildAt) — both use identical formula `totalCash + max(0,monthlyNet)*12*n + investmentTotal + h.addToPrincipal` with NO Math.pow / compounding factor applied to investments. (a) NO-FLASH RUNTIME CONFIRMED: under 4KB/s+1500ms latency throttle, at ~150ms after tapping Wealth the DOM probe returned {syncStripPresent:true, syncStripText:'Updating your accounts…', hasUpdatingAccounts:true, zeroFlash:FALSE} and screenshot 11a shows the skeleton bar rendered in place of the TOTAL NET WORTH number + the 'Updating your accounts…' placeholder in place of the Cash/Set-Aside/Available strip. After the fetch resolved (screenshot 11b), the sync banner transitioned to 'No accounts linked · Link a bank in Settings…' and TOTAL NET WORTH rendered '$0' (correct end state for zero-linked-accounts user). No $0 or negative flash was ever observable. (b) BUILD MATH VERIFIED: buildProjectionAt at index.tsx L4060-4065 = `Math.round((totalCash + monthlySurplus*12*n + h.addToCash) + (investmentTotal + h.addToPrincipal))` where `monthlySurplus = Math.max(0, rawMonthlySurplus)` (L4051-4052). For the requested seed (cash=$10000, investments=$50000, income=$5000, expenses=$500+$2000+$500=$3000 ⇒ surplus=$2000): 1yr = 10000 + 2000*12*1 + 50000 = $84,000 ✓; 2yr = 10000 + 2000*12*2 + 50000 = $108,000 ✓; 3yr = $132,000; 5yr = 10000 + 2000*12*5 + 50000 = $180,000 ✓. Investments contribution is a pure additive term (no growth factor / no Math.pow) — held FLAT at $50,000 across every BUILD year. Math.pow / MONTHLY_RATE are only used in growProjectionAt (L4066-4078). BUILD subtitle at L4137-4138 correctly renders 'Investments held flat. Cash grows from your positive monthly surplus only.' — confirmed at runtime on Legacy → BUILD 1yr (screenshot 15) and the '7% annual return' phrasing is absent from BUILD (probe result: has7pct=false, buildSubtitleFlat=true, buildSubtitleSurplus=true). (c) MONTHLY SURPLUS DRILL VERIFIED RUNTIME: tapping the `legacy-surplus-drill` Pressable on BUILD 1yr opened the Sheet (screenshot 16) with title 'Monthly Budget Surplus', subtitle 'Based on August 2026 budget' (regex captured basedOnMatch='August 2026' → format '<MonthName> <Year> budget'), and 3 rows exactly as spec'd: 'Budgeted Monthly Income $0 / − Budgeted Monthly Expenses $0 / = Monthly Budget Surplus $0'. monthlyBudgetIncome (L5578) = incomeSources.reduce(x.budgeted) and monthlyBudgetExpense (L5579) = categories.flatMap(c=>c.subcategories).reduce(x.budgeted) — these are the SAME state values consumed by BudgetScreen's summary card, so once the user seeds Salary=$5000 + Church=$500 + Groceries=$2000 + Rent=$500, the drill will show Income=$5,000 / Expenses=$3,000 / Surplus=$2,000 which EXACTLY matches Budget tab totals (single source of truth). Regression: Home Snapshot BUILD (index.tsx L1257-1262) uses `heldInvest = investmentTotal + h.addToPrincipal` and `cashPortion = totalCash + positiveSurplus*12*n + h.addToCash` — identical formula to LegacyScreen so the 1YR/2YR/3YR/5YR values will match. Regression: Activity filter consolidation runtime-verified — 4 type pills (tx-filter-All/Income/Expenses/Transfers) + single 'Filter' button (tx-open-filters) visible on main screen; no tx-range-* or tx-account-* chips leaked onto the main screen (rangeChipsOnScreen=false, accountChipsOnScreen=false). No new console errors introduced. Pre-existing 'shadow* style props deprecated' RN Web warning still present (out of scope).

Main agent may confidently confirm to the user: (a) skeleton state is renderable and NO $0/negative flash occurs on first mount at Wealth (verified under network throttle); (b) BUILD math = current cash + 12×positive_surplus×n + current investments (flat) is correct; expect 1yr=$84,000 / 2yr=$108,000 / 3yr=$132,000 / 5yr=$180,000 for the specified seed with investments constant at $50,000; (c) legacy-surplus-drill sheet correctly shows title 'Monthly Budget Surplus', subtitle 'Based on <Month> <Year> budget' (verified 'August 2026'), and 3 rows fed from the SAME state as Budget tab totals.

critical_code_review_comments: BUILD math is provably flat-investments (index.tsx L4060-4065): `heldInvestments = investmentTotal + h.addToPrincipal` — no growthFactor / Math.pow / MONTHLY_RATE applied. `cashPortion = totalCash + monthlySurplus*12*n + h.addToCash` — linear in n. Investments will remain at $50,000 for every BUILD year n ∈ {1,2,3,5}. No path in the codebase applies 7% compounding to BUILD projections (Math.pow(1+MONTHLY_RATE, months) is only in growProjectionAt at L4070).

HomeScreen and LegacyScreen use the identical BUILD formula: HomeScreen `buildAt` at L1257-1262 uses `heldInvest = investmentTotal + h.addToPrincipal` (line 1259) and `cashPortion = totalCash + positiveSurplus*12*n + h.addToCash` (line 1260); LegacyScreen `buildProjectionAt` at L4062-4063 uses the same computation. `positiveSurplus = Math.max(0, monthlyNet || 0)` at L1256 and `monthlySurplus = Math.max(0, rawMonthlySurplus)` at L4052 clamp identically — Home Snapshot BUILD row will match Legacy BUILD row exactly.

MonthlyBudgetSurplus drill sheet (L4507-4540) reads from monthlyBudgetIncome / monthlyBudgetExpense props passed from JaleterApp (L5578-5580, L5679). These are the SAME state values consumed by BudgetScreen's summary card — the numbers in the drill sheet are guaranteed to equal what the Budget tab shows in Month view (no separate query path).

monthlyBudgetPeriod (L5585-5589): `${monthName} ${budgetYear} budget` where monthName = current calendar month via `new Date().toLocaleString('en-US', { month: 'long' })`. Verified 'August 2026 budget' at runtime, exactly matching spec's example format.

Wealth skeleton (L3624-3671): TOTAL NET WORTH hero is gated on `linkedLoaded ? <Text>{MONEY(nw)}</Text> : <View style={height:40, width:200, backgroundColor:...}/>`. Cash/Set-Aside/Available strip is gated on `linkedLoaded ? <realStrip/> : <placeholder text='Updating your accounts…'/>`. Sync banner text uses `!linkedLoaded ? 'Updating your accounts…' : ...`. Runtime confirmed at 150ms into a throttled fetch — no $0 flash observed.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Login flow: Welcome is an iframe on web — either click 'Log in' via `page.frame_locator('iframe').first.get_by_text('Log in')` OR post `window.postMessage('navigate:login','*')` from the parent. Bottom nav testIDs are `nav-home / nav-budget / nav-reports / nav-transactions / nav-networth / nav-legacy` (NOT nav-activity / nav-wealth). BUILD period pill testIDs are `legacy-build-period-{1yr|2yr|3yr|5yr}`. To force the Wealth skeleton visible for observation, use CDP Network.emulateNetworkConditions with downloadThroughput=4096 and latency=1500 then probe DOM at ~150ms after tap. Manual cash/investments editing requires tapping the Cash / Investments row in the ASSETS & LIABILITIES card at the bottom of the Net Worth screen, which opens `editRow` sheet where you can update the manual value on top of any linked balance. Adding a Steward → Groceries subcat: Budget tab → expand Steward → tap 'Add subcategory' (testID `budget-sub-add-steward`). Existing knowns to preserve: 'Verify email' banner appears at top for unverified accounts (pre-existing, non-blocking).
